newsitem.title: USA: IBM stock hit by renewed earnings fears, leads Dow lower.
newsitem.headline: IBM stock hit by renewed earnings fears, leads Dow lower.

text.p: The stock of International Business Machines Corp. continued to fall on Friday after Merrill Lynch became the latest brokerage to lower its earnings estimate for the giant computer company.

IBM fell $1.75 to $129.625 on the New York Stock Exchange, where it was the second most-actively traded issue. Merrill analyst Dan Mandresh cut his estimate for IBM's first-quarter earnings to $2.10 from $2.32 a share.
The IBM decline helped fuel an early sell-off in blue chip stocks that was also prompted by the government's strong March employment report.
Two weeks ago three Wall Street firms made negative comments about IBM and two lowered their earnings estimates.
There were also reports this week that analysts may not be through cutting their estimates of IBM's earnings, which are due April 23.
The reports cited fears that a stronger dollar and a mainframe product transition will hurt IBM's first-quarter earnings.
